ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nFACTORS = {\\"clv\\": .30, \\"peer\\": .25, \\"reversal\\": .20, \\"momentum\\": .17, \\"intraday\\": .08}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W, CADENCE = .015, .16, 10\\nlast_decision = None\\n\\n\\ndef rank(x):\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    n = len(valid)\\n    if n > 1:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.) / n\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef project(raw):\\n    # Iterative box/simplex projection: complete, long-only allocation.\\n    w = {s: max(0., float(raw.get(s, 0.))) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for _ in range(50):\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if MIN_W < w[s] < MAX_W]\\n        fixed = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in free]\\n        for s in fixed:\\n            w[s] = min(MAX_W, max(MIN_W, w[s]))\\n        rem = 1. - 1.\\n        data[s] = (c, h, l, r, str(df.iloc[-1].date))\\n    if len(data) < 12:\\n        return\\n    date = max(v[4] for v in data.values())\\n    if last_decision is not None:\\n        try:\\n            elapsed = (np.datetime64(date, \\"D\\") -
